deadline.value: May 1 for fall semester international applicants per central Graduate School deadline.

gre_general.value: Submission of Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are optional.
gre_general.quote: Submission of Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are optional.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Mechanical Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission to the Ph.D. program is contingent upon the approval of an ME graduate faculty to serve as permanent Ph.D. advisor.
supervisor.quote: The admission to the Ph.D. program is contingent upon the approval of an Mechanical Engineering graduate faculty to serve as the permanent Ph.D. advisor for the applicant.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships and departmental support available.
funding.quote: Find support for research, assistantships, travel and conferences in Detroit and beyond.

entry_route.value: All students must have an MS in Mechanical Engineering or very similar field.
entry_route.quote: All students must have a M.S. in Mechanical Engineering or a very similar field. Applicants without a M.S. in Mechanical Engineering are considered on a case-by-case basis.
